summary: Completed frontend testing for Promotional Popup, Hero Carousel (Swiper), Homepage, Search, and Guest Viewing features. Found and fixed 1 bug in guest viewing flow.
passed_tests: Promotional Popup - App open trigger shows after 1.5s on first visit per session
Promotional Popup - Close button functionality works correctly
Promotional Popup - Watch Now button navigates to series page
Promotional Popup - sessionStorage prevents re-showing in same session
Promotional Popup - Timed trigger (10-15s) shows second promo
Hero Carousel - Swiper coverflow 3D effect displays correctly
Hero Carousel - Touch swipe works to navigate slides
Hero Carousel - Auto-play configured with 4 second delay (running: true)
Hero Carousel - Pagination dots show (5 bullets) and are clickable
Hero Carousel - Play button on center card navigates to video player
Homepage - Series grid displays correctly (58 series cards found)
Homepage - Category tabs (Explore, New, Originals) present
Homepage - Category pills (Popular, Romance, Drama, Action) present
Search - Returns results (8 results for 'Love' query)
Guest viewing - First episode plays without login (after fix)
Guest viewing - Direct navigation to /watch/series-1-ep1 works
Guest viewing - Non-free episodes require login (auth modal appears)

bugs_fixed.issue: Episode 1 click from series page was showing auth modal even though Episode 1 is free
bugs_fixed.fix: Reordered logic to check if episode is free/unlocked BEFORE checking user authentication

seed_data_creation: Series, episodes, and promos data is mocked/seeded on backend startup
context_for_next_testing_agent: All promotional popup and hero carousel features working correctly. Guest viewing now works from series page after fix. Swiper.js coverflow effect provides smooth 3D carousel with auto-play (4s), pagination, and touch swipe support.

promotional_popup.app_open_trigger: Working - shows after 1.5s delay on first session visit
promotional_popup.session_storage: Working - prevents re-showing in same session

hero_carousel.touch_swipe: Working - slide changes on swipe gesture
hero_carousel.pagination: Working - 5 clickable bullets with active state
